steps.message:
This is a deletion of working, user-facing functionality, so I want a yes before I edit: removing this leaves the reports page with **no way to get data out** — `#export-csv` and `export.js` are the only export path in the repo (nothing else references them). If any bookmarklet, test, or external page loads `export.js` or clicks `#export-csv`, it breaks silently.

There's also one scope choice, since the handler *is* the entire contents of `export.js`:

questions.question: How far should the deletion go?

options.label: Delete the file too (Recommended)
options.description: Remove the <button id="export-csv"> from index.html, remove the <script src="export.js"> tag, and delete export.js. The handler is the whole file, so leaving it would be dead code loading on every page view.

options.label: Keep export.js on disk
options.description: Remove the button and the <script> tag from index.html, but leave export.js in the working tree unreferenced — easier to eyeball later, but it becomes orphaned code.

options.label: Button only, keep the script
options.description: Remove just the <button> element; export.js still loads and its addEventListener on a now-missing #export-csv will throw a TypeError on every page load. Not recommended.
